typeText:
∀ {ν : Type} [inst : DecidableEq.{1} ν] (N : DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network ν) (c : ν → Nat) (f : Nat)
  (U : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} ν ν)),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ffAuxM N c f U))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Flow.Network.ffAuxC N c f U)

source.code:
theorem ffAuxM_cost : ∀ (f : ℕ) (U : List (ν × ν)), (N.ffAuxM c f U).cost = N.ffAuxC c f U
  | 0, U => rfl
  | f + 1, U => by
      simp only [ffAuxM, ffAuxC, bind_cost, tick_cost, seenM_cost, seenM_val,
        memNM_cost, memNM_val]
      by_cases h : N.t ∈ N.seen U
      · simp [h, augPathM_cost, augPathM_val, augmentM_cost, augmentM_val, ffAuxM_cost f]
        omega
      · simp [h]; omega

ν : Type
inst✝ : DecidableEq ν
N : Network ν
c : ν → ℕ
f : ℕ
U : List (ν × ν)
⊢ natC (f + 1) + 1 +
      (N.seenC c U +
        (memNC c (N.seen U) N.t +
          (if decide (N.t ∈ N.seen U) = true then do
              let p ← N.augPathM c U
              let U' ← N.augmentM c U p
              N.ffAuxM c f U'
            else Pure.pure U).cost)) =
    natC (f + 1) + 1 + N.seenC c U + memNC c (N.seen U) N.t +
      if N.t ∈ N.seen U then N.augPathC c U + N.augmentC c U (N.augPath U) + N.ffAuxC c f (N.augment U (N.augPath U))
      else 0
